property_summary: For every admissible call to transfer with a non-empty _tos list, the number of transferFrom calls and the per-recipient amounts recorded by the external callee must match the input list one-to-one; the mutant skips the first element, so the recorded counts/amounts for _tos[0] are missing and the call count is one less than _tos.length.
